method: Read-only installed-file PE/resource inspection, static extension review, targeted Ghidra/Capstone traces, UDM source audit and one isolated local HTTP reproduction.

gaps.missing: Ordinary browser handoff does not preserve POST method/body; the local POST-only export fails with HTTP 405.
gaps.idmEvidence: Extension background.js 2504–2544 and body serializer Bc; controlled UDM fixture.

gaps.missing: Ordinary handoff forwards selected context only, without the original Authorization or arbitrary required request headers. Manual site logins are a separate implemented path.
gaps.idmEvidence: Extension requestHeaders handling and native message packing near 2390–2460.

gaps.missing: No per-download propagation of the browser proxy configuration. System/manual desktop proxy settings do not establish equivalence.
gaps.idmEvidence: Extension proxy.settings observers and proxyInfo packing at 2448, 2548, 2619.

gaps.missing: No SOCKS4/5 editor, proxy DNS option or separate protocol-specific proxy controls.
No equivalent rotation/retry of failed files as queue jobs. Current HTTP request retry/backoff is implemented but different.
No queue type that checks remote changes, replaces changed files and retains membership for later synchronization.
No repeat-every-N-minutes/hours schedule. Daily and one-time windows exist.
No per-file or per-queue run-file/program, disconnect, app-exit or shutdown workflow.
gaps.udmSource: native/Core.cpp Manager::start; native/Ui.hpp Progress; native/WorkflowsUi.hpp Scheduler

gaps.missing: Global suppression and minimized queue progress exist; no complete scheduler-specific completion/error suppression policy.
No full queue-tree context menus/toolbar chooser or explicit per-queue start-on-IDM-startup equivalent.
No dragging files within or between queues; up/down and membership commands exist.
gaps.idmEvidence: Official scheduler Files in the queue behavior.

gaps.missing: No configurable force/bypass combinations for browser capture.
Host exclusions exist; no complete per-URL wildcard exception editor.
No offer to exclude an address/site after a repeatedly cancelled automatic capture.
No complete per-media-type/minimum-size editor, full/mini mode and independent video-panel exception workflow; live overlay placement needs more site coverage.
Selected-link capture exists; missing the complete type-filter, wildcard rename, destination/category and link-description review workflow.
Only text URL lists are implemented. No structured history format/import route comparable to the separate IDM formats.
gaps.idmEvidence: Commands 32816/32821; wrappers 0x00482770/0x00482760; import function 0x00477fa0 distinguishes .ef2/.ief from .txt.

gaps.missing: No dedicated export-selected/export-queue/export-all chooser.
No configurable toolbar button selection/order, size or skin workflow.
gaps.idmEvidence: Command 33001 -> 0x004581f0 -> 0x00455440 sends the toolbar customization message; commands 34010/34011.

gaps.missing: The main window accepts drops; there is no independent floating basket.
gaps.idmEvidence: Dialog 187; command 32809 -> 0x00456de0 toggles its window visibility.

gaps.missing: Removing history does not provide IDM’s explicit companion disk-file deletion option.
No completed-file drag source for another app/Explorer.
No ZIP contents inspection/download preview dialog.
Find Next exists; no field selector, match-case or whole-string-only settings.
gaps.idmEvidence: Dialog 506; Find Next 0x0047c2a0 calls record matcher 0x0045fd40.

gaps.missing: Rules/custom categories exist; rename/delete and last-used category destination workflows are incomplete.
gaps.idmEvidence: Category dialogs and Save To controls; official Options documentation.

gaps.missing: No matching tab visibility, initial view and per-download completion-options configuration.
No native Options preference for startup registration.
Completion sound exists; there is no full configurable sound-per-event editor.
gaps.idmEvidence: Sounds resource and official Options documentation.

gaps.missing: No editable User-Agent for manually added downloads; browser-captured User-Agent is separate.
Encrypted origin-based saved credentials exist; different paths of the same site cannot select different saved credentials.
Fresh sequential FTP exists; resumable FTP, full passive/proxy configuration and live coverage remain incomplete.
gaps.idmEvidence: FTP/proxy controls in dialog 140; current transfer implementation.

gaps.missing: No reusable template library/wizard.
No full page/file include-exclude rules, manual-login workflow or logout-page protection.
No independent explore-only/explore-and-download/synchronize project schedule.
No original-directory layout plus rewriting downloaded links for offline browsing.
Native UI remains English without a language catalog/selector.
Portable/current-user setup exists; no complete signed update/repair/rollback distribution workflow.
gaps.idmEvidence: Update menu/notice and installed setup components; UDM packaging.

gaps.missing: UDM’s optional WFP monitor is not equivalent to IDM’s observed redirection, process tagging and stream handling. Production signing/kernel behavior remain unverified.
gaps.idmEvidence: Hash-matched prior driver decompilation, stream callbacks and process-tag insertion; docs/reverse-engineering-2026-09-20.md.

gaps.missing: Configurable quota periods work; no matching warning-before-stop/exceeded-quota dialog.
Numeric/letter ranges work; no comparable preview grid/wildcard-size and batch-specific authorization editor.
No connection/reconnect/hang-up automation workflow.

postReproduction.finding: Current ordinary file handoff cannot replay a POST-only form-generated download; body and method are not carried from the browser.
postReproduction.scope: Local controlled server. No live IDM POST comparison.

limits: Menu/resource presence alone is not a live behavior test.
The export wrapper was disassembled; its full serialization format was not decoded.
No live IDM POST-form comparison was performed.
No universal video compatibility, speed superiority or complete original source recovery is claimed.
